core_obligations: Base change along the object: the fibre product of the source with the test scheme is surjective flat and locally of finite presentation over that scheme (proof lines 5886-5892)

Present it by a scheme: a smooth surjective morphism from a scheme onto that fibre product is itself flat and locally of finite presentation, so the composite to the test scheme is surjective flat and of finite presentation, hence an fppf covering (proof lines 5893-5908)
Conclusion: that covering together with the resulting morphism into the source is the required fppf covering and family of lifts (proof lines 5908-5909)
proof_roadmap: 把对象 y 看作 U → Y，则 X ×_Y U → U 满、平坦、局部有限表现。
取概型 V 满光滑映到 X ×_Y U ⇒ V → U 满、平坦、局部有限表现，即 fppf 覆盖；V → X 给出提升对象 x。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation of algebraic stacks admits, for every object over a scheme, an fppf covering of that scheme together with lifts of the object into the source (author lemma at source lines 5876-5884, label lemma-surjective-flat-locally-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 5886-5910) base changes along the object, presents the resulting stack by a scheme and verifies that the composite is an fppf covering (proof lines 5886-5909). The choice of the presentation and the verification of the fppf conditions are the substance. H3.
